title: Persona Evaluation and Testing
summary: This module provides tools for evaluating and testing persona steering vectors, including sanity checks, steering ramp tests, A/B comparisons, and automated quality gates.

nodes.label: Evaluate Answers
nodes.title: Evaluate Answers
nodes.description: Generates model responses to evaluation questions using positive and negative system prompts, saving them for further analysis.

nodes.label: Sanity Evaluate Projection
nodes.title: Sanity Evaluate Projection
nodes.description: Performs a sanity check by evaluating positive/negative activations projected onto persona vectors, ensuring basic vector effectiveness.

nodes.label: Steering Ramp Test
nodes.title: Steering Ramp Test
nodes.description: Conducts a 5-step steering demo, sweeping alpha values to observe the effect of persona vectors on model generation.

nodes.label: Steering A/B Comparison
nodes.title: Steering A/B Comparison
nodes.description: Compares model responses with and without persona steering, allowing for A/B testing of steering effectiveness.

nodes.label: Validate Persona Vectors
nodes.title: Validate Persona Vectors
nodes.description: Runs automated quality gates on extracted persona vectors, checking data sufficiency, separation, layer selection, and steering coherence.

nodes.label: Main CLI Entrypoint
nodes.title: Main CLI Entrypoint
nodes.description: The primary command-line interface for executing various persona evaluation and testing commands.

nodes.label: Self-Chat Gate Discovery
nodes.title: Self-Chat Gate Discovery
nodes.description: Conducts self-chat experiments using Gemma and persona vectors to discover and analyze gate behavior in conversations.

nodes.label: Run Extraction Rollouts
nodes.title: Run Extraction Rollouts
nodes.description: Executes the extraction rollout process to generate model responses based on persona prompts, without involving a judge.

nodes.label: Persona Steering and Generation
nodes.title: Persona Steering and Generation
nodes.description: Parent module responsible for the overall management and creation of persona steering mechanisms and generation processes.

nodes.label: Evaluation Steps
nodes.title: Evaluation Steps
nodes.description: A sub-module containing specific steps for persona evaluation, such as generating trait artifacts and processing rollouts.

groups.label: CLI Commands
groups.title: Command Line Interface
groups.description: Entry points for various persona evaluation and testing operations via the command line.

groups.label: Evaluation Routines
groups.title: Core Evaluation Routines
groups.description: Functions dedicated to assessing the performance and characteristics of persona vectors and steering.

groups.label: Experimentation Tools
groups.title: Experimental and Testing Tools
groups.description: Components used for conducting experiments and generating data for persona analysis.
